name: Turnip Adreno 613 FS-double-wave + multiview (RG 55G1, Android 12 / API 31)
description: Self-built Mesa Turnip (Mesa 26.3.0-devel) with two GammaOS changes: (1) multiview forced so apiVersion reports VK 1.3 (runs 3DMark Wild Life Extreme etc.); (2) fragment shaders opt into 128-wide (double-threadsize) waves when provably safe, recovering ~1.7x fragment ALU throughput on the small Adreno 613 regfile (gfxbench fp32 42->72, ~93% of the stock blob; mediump 42->84). Compute unchanged.
author: TheGammaSqueeze
sourceChanges: src/freedreno/ir3/ir3.c: fragment shaders forced to double-threadsize when branchstack/regfile/wave-count safe
verified: RG 55G1 (a28c0e0e): gfxbench fp32 71.6 / mediump 84.2 / compute 52.1; disasm shows 1 double_threadsize; flashed to /vendor and 3DMark Wild Life Extreme = 158 (vs 156 orig turnip, 174 stock), correct render
